title: 第26章 创造武学第27章 神秘人
lines: 嘶大厅中，此时一道道此起彼伏的呼吸声清晰可闻。
他们一个个的眼神都是透着一股震撼！刚刚江玄那诡异的身法就已经让他们感到江玄实力的不凡了。
然而，或许那最后的一招才是江玄最厉害的招式吧！那缭绕着金色光芒的招式到底是什么？
“莫非是极品灵诀？”
坐在云曦的身旁的便是云落凡，他的目光如电，脸上也是泛起了兴趣。
此言一出，所有的人目光都是带着一丝震动，他们怎么也没有想到，这个让他们瞧不起的江家弟子竟然拥有这样强大的攻击灵诀。
还有，他刚刚的身法，莫非也是极品灵诀？
“不对！他刚刚的身法灵诀不过是江家的一套中等灵诀天云渡，但在他的手上为什么能实展出这般威力？”
云落凡眼露疑惑，然而下一刻，他的眼睛便猛的瞪大，惊骇的道。
“莫非你你在那基础上，自己又创造了更为高等的武学！”
轰！这一刻，众人仿佛感觉心中有巨石砸落，狠狠的震荡着他们的心灵。
创造武学！那是什么概念？
一般而言，低级灵诀需要达到真元境界的武道强者才能够创造出来，而中级或高级灵诀则需要气海境的强者方能创造。
至于极品灵诀的创造者，对于他们而言，那更是传说一般的存在。
在如今的天水郡中，或许也只有城主府还有那么一两本极品灵诀。
但那些也都是城主当年在外征战后，得到朝廷的赏赐，才拥有的，如今这小子竟然能够创造武学？
这一刻，他们感觉自己仿佛在做梦一般。
“哈哈哈！不愧是我云落凡看重的人！”
“或许，今年这第一名的宝座我也是时候退位让贤了！”
云落凡的话，再度震撼了在场得所有人，他们目光火热的看着江玄，或许今天他们能够看到一场精彩的决斗。
天水郡两大绝代天骄的巅峰对决吗？
不过与他们不同的是，秦峰和秦狩两人此刻的目光变得无比的冰冷。
特别是秦峰，作为天水郡第二天骄的他，本想这一次能够和云落凡有着一场针尖对麦芒的精彩大战。
如果最后能够战胜云落凡，并抱得美人归，那该是何等的荣耀。
可是他没有想到，决斗还未开始，云曦便直接为那小子加油助威，而云落凡更是没将他放在眼里，反而对那名叫江玄的小子欣赏有加，他不甘心他不甘心。
这一刻，他望向江玄的眼中充满了恨意，甚至是杀意。
“多谢江兄手下留情！”
而在此时，那被击倒在地的苏全终于站了起来，他知道若非江玄在最后手下留情，此刻的他已成了重伤。
江玄不置可否的点了点头，随后回了自己的席位。
而接下来，又有几位天骄上前比试，不过却很少有人再去挑战江玄，很显然所有的人都知道这个柿子不好捏。
而即便有人上前，大多都是请教，而非挑战，由此可看出众人对江玄态度的变化。
然而见到此幕的秦峰面色却是变得越发难看了起来。
他终于忍不住，站了起来。
“江玄，既然云落凡如此看重你，你有本事，下来与我一战。”
此时，秦峰瞬间来到了大厅的中央，对着江玄挑衅道。
“既然你诚心诚意的问了，那我就”江玄站了起来，所有人的目光都汇聚到他的身上，难道这位本次大会最大的一匹黑马就要出手了吗？
content_en:
In the hissing hall, the sound of breathing one after another could be clearly heard.
Each of their eyes showed shock! Jiang Xuan's weird movement skills just now made them feel that Jiang Xuan's strength was extraordinary.
However, maybe that last move is Jiang Xuan's most powerful move! What is that move that is surrounded by golden light?
"Could it be the best spiritual secret?"
Sitting next to Yun Xi was Yun Luofan, his eyes were like lightning and interest appeared on his face.
As soon as these words came out, everyone's eyes were filled with shock. They never thought that this disciple of the Jiang family, whom they looked down upon, actually possessed such a powerful attack spirit.
Also, could it be that the movement technique he just performed was also a top-grade spiritual technique?
"That's not right! The movement and spiritual techniques he just used were just a set of medium-level spiritual techniques from the Jiang family, Tianyundu, but why could he display such power in his hands?"
Yun Luofan's eyes showed confusion, but the next moment, his eyes widened suddenly and he said in horror.
"Could it be that you created a more advanced martial arts on your own based on that!"
Boom! At this moment, everyone seemed to feel as if a huge boulder was falling in their hearts, severely shaking their hearts.
Create martial arts! What is that concept?
Generally speaking, low-level spiritual arts require martial arts masters who have reached the True Yuan realm to create them, while intermediate or advanced spiritual arts require strong men in the Qi Sea realm to create them.
As for the creator of the best spiritual art, to them, it is even more of a legendary existence.
In today's Tianshui County, perhaps only the City Lord's Mansion still has one or two top-quality spiritual secrets.
But those were all owned by the city lord after he was rewarded by the imperial court after the expedition. Now this kid can actually create martial arts?
At this moment, they felt as if they were in a dream.
"Hahaha! You are indeed someone I, Yun Luofan, value highly!"
"Perhaps it's time for me to abdicate my position as number one this year!"
Yun Luofan's words once again shocked everyone present. They looked at Jiang Xuan with fiery eyes. Maybe they could see a wonderful duel today.
Is this the ultimate showdown between the two most talented people in Tianshui County?
But unlike them, Qin Feng and Qin Shou's eyes became extremely cold at this moment.
Especially Qin Feng, as the second darling of Tianshui County, he originally expected to have a wonderful battle with Yun Luofan this time.
What an honor it would be if we could defeat Yun Luofan in the end and win the beauty back.
But he didn't expect that before the duel started, Yun Xi would directly cheer for the boy, and Yun Luofan didn't take him seriously. Instead, he admired the boy named Jiang Xuan. He couldn't give in to him.
At this moment, he looked at Jiang Xuan with eyes filled with hatred and even murderous intent.
"Thank you Brother Jiang for showing mercy!"
At this moment, Su Quan, who had been knocked to the ground, finally stood up. He knew that if Jiang Xuan had not shown mercy in the end, he would have been seriously injured at this moment.
Jiang Xuan nodded noncommittally, and then returned to his seat.
Then, several geniuses stepped forward to compete, but few challenged Jiang Xuan. Obviously, everyone knew that this persimmon was difficult to handle.
Even if someone came forward, most of them would ask for advice rather than challenge. From this, we can see the change in everyone's attitude towards Jiang Xuan.
However, Qin Feng's face became increasingly ugly when he saw this scene.
He finally couldn't help it and stood up.
"Jiang Xuan, since Yun Luofan values you so much, if you have the ability, come down and fight me."
At this time, Qin Feng came to the center of the hall in an instant and challenged Jiang Xuan.
"Since you asked sincerely, then I will..." Jiang Xuan stood up, and everyone's eyes focused on him. Is this conference's biggest dark horse about to take action?
